title: Navelar Logistics (NVLR3) — repricing after the sale of the road haulage arm
body: A worked example, and not investment advice: the company and the figures are invented so the crossing has something to hold. The market still prices Navelar as a low-margin road haulier. With the road haulage arm sold, what is left is a port operation with a long-term contract and net cash; the discount tends to disappear once the first pro-forma quarter is reported. Nothing here is fetched — every node reasons over what the job and the graph's own `project` block already carry.

fields.premise_source: material fact of 2026-07-30, filed with the regulator (invented, for the example)
